title: feat(spec)!: connector-attached sync leaves the connector — syncConfig / fieldMappings retired, mapping gains the connectorSource pull binding (#20281 stage 1)
body:
Part of #20281
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

Stage 1 (spec) of ruling A (`5904845660`) on #20281, as claimed in `5913026572`:

- `mapping.connectorSource` — the target-side pull binding (`connector`, `action`, optional `input` / `recordsPath` / `watermark { field, param }`); `rest` / `openapi` only, one-way, no cadence key (a `job` owns it), no credential. Declared, not executed: every row `planned`, the container `authorWarn`.
- The 14 connector keys retire: `syncConfig` and `fieldMappings` are `retiredKey()` tombstones pointing at that binding and a `job`; `DataSyncConfig`, `SyncStrategy`, `ConnectorConflictResolution`, `ConnectorFieldMapping` leave whole; D2 `connector-sync-keys-removed` (strip, never writes a mapping); D3 `connector-sync-keys-retired`.
- `packages/spec/docs/SYNC_ARCHITECTURE.md` stops presenting connector sync as delivered (rewritten, 494 to 464 lines).
- The serial constraint held: the two registry hunks were written only after merging a `main` containing #20868's landing (`9905e61ca2`), via `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`.

Local, at `674abedfd9`: spec `local` 583/583 files green (17163 passed); spec typecheck exit 0; `check:generated` 15/15 current. The derived-gate union ran at `cb54c889b9`, before the second `main` merge: 111 of 114 green. `check:platform-checklist` is red identically on `origin/main` (not this diff); `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` are NOT MEASURED (they need the whole-repo build CI does). Measurements, ablations and findings are in the `os-dev-report` comment on the card.

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/lint` still says the `mapping` ledger warns on nothing (a comment in `authoring-rules.ts` and a group-C test title in `runtime-gate.inert-type-writes.test.ts`). The ledger now warns on `connectorSource`. The tests stay green because they do not author the key. Carrier: stage 2 of #20281.
- `shared/FieldMapping` (`./shared` `FieldMappingSchema`) no longer has a carrier in the spec, because its only extender left. No carrier.
- `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts` comments still cite `integration/DataSyncConfig` as a live specimen. No carrier.

#20281 remains open for stages 2 and 3.
